The period end is inclusive, so the loop must also yield the end date.
apply_discount now does the arithmetic in binary floats and rounds with round(), which is
round-half-even on an inexact value. Half-cent results no longer round half-up as to_money does,
so invoices can be a cent short.
apply_discount(Decimal('1.15'), 50): exact result 0.575 should round half-up to 0.58
failed on the declared assertion; the same test passes on BASE
# 1.15 * 50% = 0.575 exactly, which rounds half-up to 0.58 like every other amount.
(verified: the repro passes with this patch)
Keep the arithmetic in Decimal and round with to_money. Converting the percentage through str()
keeps a float such as 12.5 at its printed value instead of its binary approximation.
